about: Story-template library for hushmallow Infinite Studio: 10-20 s (default 15 s) loopable 9:16 shorts in the approved v2 format (hook -> escalation -> Hushmallow moment -> resolution -> loop). Data only: the generator compiles a template + slot picks into a v2-style direction (body/face/camera/light/palette tracks, bubbles, cues). Validate with: node templates/validate-library.mjs

structure: HOOK (cover caption + physical gag landing <= 1.0 s)
ESCALATION (3 feeling lines + one visual metaphor)
HUSHMALLOW MOMENT (one physical, satisfying, safe ritual + the realm's transform)
RESOLUTION (insight line or brand line + logo + hushmallow.com)
LOOP (end state == cover state, hook caption returns)

layout.mallowScale: 0.56 of the 1254 px approved art (always a downsample, never upscaled)

hook.fit: auto-shrink from 76 px (<= 20 chars/line) down to a 50 px floor so a 32-char line fits in 960 px

thoughtBubble.wrap: 2 lines max, <= 17 chars per wrapped line, break at the word boundary nearest the middle

logoCard.plate: approved black-on-white wordmark, untouched, on its soft off-white plate (no reversed version exists)

layout.safeZones: Key text inside x 60-1020, y 180-1250. Nothing important in the right rail (x > 900, y 700-1500) or under the platform caption area (y > 1500). The Mallow's face stays above y 1250.

format.typography: Fredoka, white with soft ink shadow, no outlines (stage2/type.js). Entrances are a gentle rise + fade only. Store ASCII in data; render straight quotes/apostrophes as typographic ones.
format.restFace: Frames 0-0.17 s and the last 0.5 s show the untouched approved painted face (v2 restAt). Expressions start after 0.17 s.

beatClocks.$doc: Absolute seconds. Gag timing is fixed (the first second never scales); the end card is anchored to the end; escalation + ritual scale. Idle breathing period = D/k so the seam is periodic.

10.note: quick rituals only (minDur <= 2.1 s); lines <= 22 chars preferred

20.note: optional 4th line drawn from any unused pool line; ritual may run its long variant

noomi.eyes: closed painted face; opens only on strong beats (eyeGate), navy galaxy iris
noomi.plays: sleepy, soothing, whimsical; reacts late and soft; big beats read as a sleepy startle
noomi.resolutionFace: eyes open softly, moon catchlights, tiny smile, slow blink, drifts shut

glitzi.eyes: open amber irises, heavy half-lids, side-eye at rest, glitch slices
glitzi.plays: sarcastic, mischievous, secretly lovable; deadpan side-eye, glitches when flustered; never gushes
glitzi.resolutionFace: a softened smirk (mouthSkew), glitch settles to 0.1 - not a beaming grin

blubi.eyes: closed painted face, brows visible; eyes open + wet on strong beats
blubi.plays: sensitive, comforting, beautifully dramatic; wobbly mouth, happy/sad tears allowed (gentle)
blubi.resolutionFace: closed-eye smile, big blush, warm glow

zuzu.eyes: spiral eyes (always open); spin speed = thought speed; open smiling mouth at rest
zuzu.plays: curious, hypnotic, playful, overthinking; spirals spin up with every thought
zuzu.resolutionFace: spirals slow to a lazy turn, open smile

boppo.eyes: open star-iris eyes, brows, open smile
boppo.plays: joyful, optimistic, bouncy, adorably chaotic; even sadness has a bounce in it

pipzi.eyes: open star-iris eyes, brows, open smile
pipzi.plays: energetic, excitable, expressive, funny; emotions come out as sparks

loomi.plays: calm, unbothered, gently amusing; under-reacts on purpose - the comedy is the contrast
loomi.resolutionFace: closed-eye smile, a slow content float

timeWords.$doc: If a hook/line contains one of these (case-insensitive), the chosen realm ToD must be in the mapped set. Places in captions (office, sofa, supermarket) are context only - the realm is never redrawn as a human location.

gags.$doc: Physical comedic hook beats. Body-only (Mallows have no limbs): squash, stretch, inflate, lift/hop, lean, sway, rim shimmer, uniform scale, base slide. Impact or peak lands <= 1.0 s. Numbers are starting points for stage2/motion.js Track/Impulses/Hops.

G-JOLT.name: Jolt & flump
G-JOLT.beat: 0.26 dream flinch (sink, squash +0.07) -> 0.40 eyes snap wide (pin-prick pupils) + stretched launch (squash -0.26, hop 165 art px) -> rounds at apex -> 0.98 heavy jelly landing (kick 0.27), wave travels up, ripples
G-JOLT.sound: eye-pop, rubbery boing, water plip, flump + squelch + bloop

G-FLOP.name: Pancake flop
G-FLOP.beat: 0.30 tiny rise (anticipation) -> 0.45 collapses into a wide pancake (height 0.62, width 1.35, base spreads) -> face lands low, eyes half-lidded -> slow 'schlorp' recovery over 1.5 s
G-FLOP.sound: wet flump, long deflating squeak, sigh gesture

G-DEFLATE.name: Slow leak
G-DEFLATE.beat: 0.35 a tiny 'pip' -> inflate -0.12 over 0.6 s, body sags and droops, lean 0.03 -> 1.0 last little wobble
G-DEFLATE.sound: soft pip, 'pfffft' air squeak, descending kit glide

G-DOUBLETAKE.name: Double take
G-DOUBLETAKE.beat: 0.20 glance at the thing, glance away -> 0.45 eyes snap back + stretch (eyeStretch 1.12) + mini hop 0.15 body heights -> 0.80 small landing squash
G-DOUBLETAKE.world: the trigger object (bubble/frame/sun) moves in the gap
G-DOUBLETAKE.sound: blink bip, kit 'surprise' gesture, tiny boing

G-SINK.name: Sink to the cheeks
G-SINK.beat: 0.35 a gulp -> 0.45-1.0 slides down until the waterline/cloud-line sits just below the mouth (never covers the mouth: no underwater or breath-hold reading) -> eyes peek over
G-SINK.world: waterline clip + ring ripples; a few surface bubbles from the ripple, not from the mouth

G-LAUNCH.name: Ceiling launch
G-LAUNCH.beat: 0.30 deep crouch (squash 0.2) -> 0.42 launches straight up out of the top of frame (camera holds) -> 0.95 drops back in -> boing landing, big jelly wobble
G-LAUNCH.world: hop shadow shrinks, rings on landing
G-LAUNCH.sound: rising boing glide, whoosh out, whistle-down, landing boing

G-CRINGE.name: Cringe shrink
G-CRINGE.beat: 0.35 eyes squeeze -> 0.45 body shrinks to 0.72 scale with a blush flare, slight lean away -> 1.0 peeks

G-SCOOT.name: Nope scoot
G-SCOOT.beat: 0.30 the thing appears beside -> 0.40 lean away + three little sideways hops (base slide 160 px) -> 0.95 peeks back at it

G-JELLYFREEZE.name: Jelly freeze
G-JELLYFREEZE.beat: 0.40 a ping -> body locks (squash 0, eyes pin-prick) -> 0.45-1.2 quivers like set jelly (rim shimmer 6 Hz decaying)

G-PUFF.name: Balloon puff
G-PUFF.beat: 0.30 cheeks puff -> 0.40-0.90 inflates (+0.28) and floats up 40 px, wobbling, holding it in -> a tiny squeak leaks

G-MELT.name: Melt slide
G-MELT.beat: 0.35 starts to sag -> 0.50-1.0 melts sideways like ice cream (lean 0.08, squash 0.25, base spread) -> eyes half-lidded

G-WEEBLE.name: Weeble wobble
G-WEEBLE.beat: 0.40 a nudge (a tab, a bubble, an empty hug) -> rocks side to side (lean +/-0.06, 1.3 Hz, damped) -> never falls

G-PING.name: Ding stretch
G-PING.beat: 0.35 a glass notification bubble pops in above the head -> 0.40 body stretches tall (squash -0.15), eyes wide, hop 0.1 -> 0.90 settles
G-PING.world: bubble pops in with a spring

G-DEADPAN.name: Delayed reaction
G-DEADPAN.beat: 0.30 the event lands -> Mallow does nothing, one slow blink 0.50-0.80 -> 0.90 a tiny late boing
G-DEADPAN.face: neutral -> bored -> tiny smirk or tiny glee
G-DEADPAN.world: event happens loudly; the Mallow does not
G-DEADPAN.sound: event sound, silence, one late boing

G-BONK.name: Bonk
G-BONK.beat: 0.35 a glass block/pebble drops onto the head -> 0.45 squash 0.22, wave travels down, eyes squeeze -> 0.90 settles a bit lower

G-GLITCHSLIP.name: Glitch slip
G-GLITCHSLIP.beat: 0.40 body slices slip sideways in 3 horizontal bands (+/-24 px) -> 0.75 snap back with a crunchy chirp
G-GLITCHSLIP.world: glitch bands displace (luminance constant; max one burst per second)

G-SPINUP.name: Spiral spin-up
G-SPINUP.beat: 0.35 spirals spin up to 4x with spiral-hue shift -> body leans with them -> 0.80 tiny hop

G-SPARKPOP.name: Spark pop
G-SPARKPOP.beat: 0.40 a crackle of small sparks pops off the top (local, small, >= 0.15 s ramps, no full-frame brightening) -> hop 0.25 -> 0.90 land

G-SPLASHSIT.name: Splash sit
G-SPLASHSIT.beat: 0.40 plops down onto a lily pad -> splash droplets arc -> pad bobs -> wobbly lip

metaphors.$doc: Escalation visuals in the v2 frosted-glass language. Max 3 legible text elements on screen at once (plus captions); decoys are blurred and low-contrast. No phones, no real app UI, no people, no other characters.
metaphors.M-ORBIT: Three glass thought bubbles rise from behind the head and orbit, faster and faster; the eyes chase them (approved v2).
metaphors.M-ECHO: The sent message as one glass bubble that duplicates into an echo trail, each copy re-styled in a different 'tone' (bigger, tilted, smaller).
metaphors.M-DOTS: A glass message bubble with three dots that softly pulse (opacity wave, period >= 1.2 s), vanish, return; the Mallow leans in each time.
metaphors.M-CLOUD: A small personal cloud forms above the head, greys, and drizzles softly on the Mallow; the body droops.
metaphors.M-SWELL: The feeling fills the Mallow: it inflates a bit with each line, inner glow and slow sparkles rise inside, it starts to float.
metaphors.M-STACK: Each line lands as a glass block on the head; the stack grows and the Mallow squashes a little more under it.
metaphors.M-WEEK: Five small glass blocks (M T W T F) drop in from above one by one and hover; the sun slides lower with each.
metaphors.M-METER: A glass battery pill above the head in the Mallow's glow colour; one segment dims per line; the last segment pulses slowly (>= 1.2 s period).
metaphors.M-TABS: Glass tab cards pop in around the head; the 3 legible ones are the lines, 6-12 blurred decoy tabs crowd behind; the body squashes under the clutter.
metaphors.M-LOOM: One small glass task card beside the Mallow swells with each line until it towers and casts a shadow over it.
metaphors.M-FRAMES: Shiny glass frames scroll up past the Mallow, each with a sparkly abstract scene (sun over sea, trophy, little house); the Mallow's own glow dims.
metaphors.M-FARGLOW: Warm lantern-lit windows glow on a far island/hill (the plans elsewhere); each line, that glow warms while the Mallow's light cools.
metaphors.M-CLOCK: A glass clock face hovers; its hands crawl in slow motion or tick faster; the Mallow melts lower with each line.
metaphors.M-SPOTLIGHT: A soft spotlight cone narrows on the Mallow; the world dims around it (fade >= 0.3 s, never a hard switch).
metaphors.M-JITTERS: Tiny sparks and fizz crackle around the Mallow's rim, intensifying with each line; the rim quivers more.
metaphors.M-FORK: Two glass option bubbles pull left and right; the body leans/stretches toward each in turn, ping-pong getting faster.
metaphors.M-NOISE: Soft sound-rings and small glass onomatopoeia bubbles ('beep', 'bzz') drift in from the edges and overlap; never more than 6 elements, low contrast, slow.
metaphors.M-BUZZ: A glowing bubble emits soft concentric vibration rings that nudge the Mallow and ripple the ground; rings come faster.
metaphors.M-PEBBLES: Small grey glass pebbles bonk the Mallow one by one, each adding a puff to a grumpy little cloud (no lightning flashes).
metaphors.M-ICONS: Glass chore icons (sock, envelope, plate) orbit and poke at the Mallow while it tries to lie still.
metaphors.M-COSYPILE: Cosy cloud-cushions drop in one by one (soft, squishy landings) while the Mallow tries and fails to look sad.
metaphors.M-FOG: Mist rolls in, the moon/sun dims; each line is a soft memory bubble that drifts just out of reach.
metaphors.M-DREAMBUBBLES: Warm, slightly sepia glass memory bubbles rise like the realm's dream bubbles, each carrying a line; the grade warms toward nostalgia.
metaphors.M-GLOW: Positive escalation: blush spreads, slow hearts or golden stars rise (fxHeart/fxStar), the Mallow glows and grows a little prouder with each line.
metaphors.M-TEARS: Eyes well; little tear droplets lift off in gentle arcs that build to comic 'waterworks' (slow, soft, no splash flashing).

rituals.$doc: The Hushmallow moment. Physical, satisfying, safe; performed by the Mallow (never an instruction to the viewer). Every ritual ends by triggering the realm's own transform (from the app's realm code) at 30-100%. Times are fractions of the RITUAL window. minDur = shortest allowed version (the 10 s clock gives 2.1 s, 12 s gives 3.3 s); idealDur = full version. mallows = who may perform it (realm props / signature systems).

R-BREATH.name: One big breath
R-BREATH.beat: 0.00 squeeze-and-let-go; 0.10-0.45 one slow inhale (body swells tall, lifts 36 px, thoughts drawn close; >= 1.2 s); natural soft crest <= 0.35 s, never labelled; 0.50-0.95 long elastic exhale melt (>= 1.5x the inhale) - calm ring spreads, the breath carries the thoughts away (words fade first, glass turns to warm motes)
R-BREATH.safety: no counts, no holds, no on-screen breathing instructions, no fast breathing
R-BREATH.sound: breathe-in air, soft crest, breathe-out, release squelch, glass chimes + sparkles, warm pad

R-SQUISH.name: The squish
R-SQUISH.beat: 0.00-0.30 slow press-down into a deep squash (height 0.62, ease-in); 0.30-0.45 squished wobble (rim shimmer); 0.45-0.80 slow rise with a jelly overshoot; the thoughts compress into one glowing pebble that melts into the glow
R-SQUISH.sound: long squoosh, creak, satisfying pop-back boing

R-COSY.name: Cosy shrink
R-COSY.beat: shrinks round to 0.78 scale; a realm blanket (moonmilk cloud, lily-pad leaf, festival bunting-cloud, sunbeam haze) settles over the top like a duvet, face still visible; warm inner glow; content blink
R-COSY.sound: blanket swish, cosy hum, content sigh gesture

R-CLOUDWRAP.name: Cloud wrap
R-CLOUDWRAP.beat: a soft cloud drifts down and wraps around the body (front layer at the base, back layer behind), a gentle squeeze (squash 0.05), the face relaxes, glow rises; the cloud lifts into motes or stays as cosy

R-NAMEIT.name: Name it, softly
R-NAMEIT.beat: the bubbles drift together into one; the words blur and resolve into a single everyday feeling word (template nameWords); the Mallow gives a small nod (squash 0.25); the bubble warms and settles beside it, then fades into the glow
R-NAMEIT.safety: the word is an everyday feeling word, lowercase, never a diagnosis or label of a person
R-NAMEIT.sound: glass merge shimmer, one warm bell, nod tap

R-FLOAT-AWAY.name: Let it float
R-FLOAT-AWAY.beat: the Mallow rises a little and boops the bubble (tap: squash 0.2, lift 20 px); it floats up slowly, shrinking, past the moon/sun and becomes a star, lantern or mote (realm-specific); eyes follow it up; a relaxed settle
R-FLOAT-AWAY.sound: boop tap, rising shimmer, star ting

R-DRIFT.name: Lie back and drift
R-DRIFT.beat: body softens and spreads (squash +0.1), bobs gently on the water (2.5 s period), drifts 40 px aside and back; ripples still to a mirror; the escalation objects float off like leaves
R-DRIFT.safety: stays on the surface; never sinks
R-DRIFT.sound: water lap, slow wind, soft bloops as things float off

R-LANTERN.name: Fold it into a lantern
R-LANTERN.beat: the thoughts fold (paper-fold) into a paper lantern that lights warm and rises; realm lanterns light one by one (Spark Festival transform)
R-LANTERN.safety: no fire imagery beyond a soft glow
R-LANTERN.sound: paper folds, pluck as it lights, rising shimmer

R-SPIRALSLOW.name: Slow the spiral
R-SPIRALSLOW.beat: spirals slow from spin 3 to 0.1; tangled ribbons straighten into one clean orbit; the galaxy resolves and the dome shutter slides open (Spiral Observatory transform)
R-SPIRALSLOW.sound: warble slowing to a hum, rotate-tick, lens-focus, chime

R-DEFRAG.name: Realign
R-DEFRAG.beat: slipped slices realign one at a time with soft clicks (3); constellations snap into clean geometry; the cracked floor heals into a golden mandala; dawn glow; a grudging smirk
R-DEFRAG.sound: three soft clicks, sort fx, unlock, warm swell

R-SUNSOAK.name: Sun soak
R-SUNSOAK.beat: a sunbeam finds the Mallow; a slow golden warmth fills from base to top; body softens wide (squash +0.06); a soft rainbow arcs behind (Sunpop transform)
R-SUNSOAK.safety: sun disc never brightens > 8%, ramps >= 0.5 s
R-SUNSOAK.sound: warm swell, bloom fx, kit hum

R-RAINLIFT.name: Raindrops up
R-RAINLIFT.beat: the rain stops; hanging drops and tears lift upward one by one and turn to light (Raindrop Lagoon clarity transform); the Mallow rises a touch with them
R-RAINLIFT.sound: drips reversing into rising droplet chimes

R-WIGGLE.name: Wiggle it loose
R-WIGGLE.beat: a slow jelly wiggle travels base -> top (sway <= 2 Hz, 3 damped cycles); little sparkles/droplets flick off (the annoyances); ends round and fresh with a tiny hop
R-WIGGLE.safety: body motion only; camera and text stay still
R-WIGGLE.sound: bwowow wobble, sparkle flicks, settle fx

R-STRETCH.name: Big stretch
R-STRETCH.beat: stretches extra tall (1.22 height, lift 30 px), a yawn, a tiny tremble at the top, then pops back round with a satisfying wobble and a fresh blink
R-STRETCH.sound: rubbery creak glide up, yawn gesture, pop-back boing

R-SETDOWN.name: Set it down
R-SETDOWN.beat: the weight leaves one piece at a time: blocks slide off and set down beside it with soft thunks / tabs fold shut with paper clicks; the body springs back taller with each; optionally one keeper item stays, glowing
R-SETDOWN.sound: shhk + thunk x3 (or paper clicks), spring boing, relief sigh

R-SAVOUR.name: Let it glow
R-SAVOUR.beat: the Mallow lets the good feeling fill it: slow golden glow bloom from inside (glow 0 -> 1.2), body rises softly (float 0.4), one soft happy hop, sparkles drift up slowly (no burst), content closed-eye smile
R-SAVOUR.sound: bloom fx, kit 'celebrate' gesture at low intensity, star sparkle

R-BOOP-SIZE.name: Boop it back to size
R-BOOP-SIZE.beat: the Mallow boops the looming thing; it deflates back to its real tiny size with a squeaky pfff; one nudge and it folds into a small glowing tick
R-BOOP-SIZE.sound: boop tap, deflate squeak, unlock + success gesture

loops.$doc: Every template uses LP-BASE plus one strategy. Seam QA: mean |delta| at frame N-1 -> 0 must not exceed the film's in-film keyframe deltas (v2: 1.89 vs 2.02-2.09).
loops.LP-BASE: All periodic motion (breath, sky, water, stars, bobbing) has period D/k; palette and pose at D equal frame 0; the realm bed and any loop-crossing sound are periodic; hook caption returns at HOOK_IN (D-0.34) in the identical position.
loops.LP-RETURN: Return to cover: the Mallow settles back into the exact cover pose and rest face (v2: eyes drift shut, warmth eases back).
loops.LP-RETRIGGER: The final second re-introduces the hook trigger (the dots reappear, a new tab pops, the buzz returns) so the loop reads 'here we go again'; frame 0 already shows it.
loops.LP-CYCLE: The story is cyclical (sun dips and comes back, morning returns); the world grade wraps through the end card back to the cover.
loops.LP-OBJECT: Match on an object: the released bubble/lantern/star drifts out the top; at frame 0 a new one is arriving from behind the head, continuing the same motion direction.

cameras.$doc: One continuous shot, no cuts. Zoom 0.95-1.10, |zoom velocity| <= 0.04/s, vertical drift <= 40 px/s, no roll, no shake, no whip moves; sky parallax 0.35 of the foreground.
cameras.C-DRIFT-IN: Locked framing; slow push-in 1.00 -> 1.075 across the escalation, ease back to 1.00 through the ritual (approved v2).
cameras.C-HOLD-WIDE: Locked wide at 0.96 for headroom (stacks, launches, distant objects); a 1.03 push only during the ritual.
cameras.C-FOLLOW-SOFT: Soft vertical follow of 0.2 x lift on hops and floats; otherwise still.
cameras.C-PULL-BACK: Starts close (1.08) on the face for the hook, eases back to 1.00 to reveal the metaphor, returns to 1.08 over the last 1.5 s for the loop.
cameras.C-LOW-HERO: Horizon 60 px lower and a gentle rise (y -24 px) for pride and joy beats.

paletteArcs.$doc: Keyframes on the app's realm mood axes [agitation, heaviness, clarity, warmth] at beat names; values at END equal COVER. The Mallow is relit only (light hue/intensity), never recoloured. Anti-flash: exposure changes <= 12% and ramp over >= 0.5 s; no frame-to-frame relative-luminance change >= 10% over >= 25% of the frame, ever.

A-DIM-CONE-OPEN.note: spotlight cone narrows to the PEAK, opens into general warm light on the exhale

A-DUSK-DIP-GOLD.note: the sun slides down with the dread and inches back up during the ritual

scoreMotifs.$doc: Music-less score: realm bed (app REALM_BEDS, driven by the same 4 mood curves) + Mallow kit gestures (app GESTURES) + cue-synced procedural foley. Pitch material is the Mallow kit's major pentatonic only; resolution contours rise or arch, never fall at the end. No samples, no music library, no real-product sounds (no phone ringtones, messenger pops or alarm tones), no heartbeat sounds, no jump-scare stingers; app audio rules (soft attacks >= 3 ms, nothing harsh) apply.
scoreMotifs.MO-TICK: Clock tick, 0.5 s -> 0.18 s period with agitation; stops dead at TURN.
scoreMotifs.MO-DOTS: Three soft plinks (degrees 0-2-4) per 1.2 s typing cycle; a 'fwip' when the dots vanish.
scoreMotifs.MO-GLASS-RISE: A glass ting per line arrival on degrees 0/2/4 (or 4/2/0 for deflating moods), panned to the bubble.
scoreMotifs.MO-ORBIT: Orbit whooshes panned to each bubble, faster with PEAK.
scoreMotifs.MO-HUM: Tension tone (filtered saw + pad) whose cutoff follows agitation; max -24 dBFS; consonant only; ducks to silence at TURN.
scoreMotifs.MO-THUNK: Weighted glass landings, each a step lower.
scoreMotifs.MO-POP: Card/tab pops, each a step higher.
scoreMotifs.MO-BUZZ: Soft low vibration pattern (2 x 0.4 s, 0.8 s gap), low-passed; never a ringtone.
scoreMotifs.MO-FIZZ: Soft crackle grains; density follows excitement/nerves.
scoreMotifs.MO-MURMUR: Pitched noise grains suggesting a crowd (never voices or words).
scoreMotifs.MO-MUSICBOX: A slow, original 3-4 note celesta phrase (memory / 'the advert music' / 'the old song').
scoreMotifs.MO-WARMPAD: Warm pad (kit root, major add9) entering on the ritual exhale/peak; carries to the logo.
scoreMotifs.MO-CLOSE: Mallow content gesture (comfort / release / celebrate) on OPEN + closing chime on LOGO (always).

brand.closerRule: The end card shows EITHER the template's insight line OR a brand closer (about 30% brand closer, higher on positive templates) - never both. Then the untouched logo on its plate + 'hushmallow.com'.
brand.nameRule: Brand name is always lowercase 'hushmallow' in any copy; URL lowercase 'hushmallow.com'. The logo is never recoloured, stretched, outlined, cropped, animated beyond a fade, or placed without its plate.

copyRules.hook: ALL CAPS, 1-2 lines, <= 32 chars per line (<= 22 preferred for full 76 px size); at most one '?' or '!'; no emoji; no hashtags; time words must agree with the realm ToD (timeWords).
copyRules.thought: Sentence case, <= 28 chars, must wrap into <= 2 bubble lines of <= 17 chars; one feeling beat per line; no breath words in the escalation (the breath belongs to the ritual).
copyRules.resolution: <= 2 lines, <= 28 chars per line, reads well in all-lowercase (no proper nouns/acronyms), an observation or kindness - never an instruction to fix, never an outcome promise.
copyRules.general: Relatable and kind: never mocks the viewer, never catastrophic. No self-hatred, self-harm, death (even as a joke), illness, body/weight/food-guilt, alcohol, drugs, or appearance comparisons. No real brands, apps, people or places by name. One Mallow per video; no humans; no generic or new characters.

medicalTherapyFlags.$doc: Copy that could read as medical or therapy advice or as a clinical claim. The validator rejects 'banned' terms everywhere and warns on 'caution' terms.

replacements.imposter syndrome: imposter feeling / feeling like a fraud
replacements.anxiety / anxious / panic: nervous, jittery, on edge, wobbly, the spiral
replacements.overstimulated / sensory overload: a lot, too loud, too much
replacements.brain fog / burnout: 3 pm slump, running on empty, social battery
replacements.intrusive thoughts / rumination: that random cringe memory, the replay, overthinking
replacements.calms your nervous system / reduces stre: (no claim - show the Mallow's moment and let it speak)
replacements.breathing exercise / breathe in for 4: (no instruction - the Mallow takes one big breath on screen)
replacements.set boundaries: a kind no, your time counts too
replacements.stop overthinking / fix your feelings: give it somewhere soft to land

decisionsInThisLibrary: Imposter template is framed as 'imposter feeling' / 'fraud' - never 'imposter syndrome'.
Removed 'What's wrong with me?' from the rejection pool (self-blame) -> 'What did I miss?'.
Removed 'Did I lock the door?' from the tabs pool (repeat-checking reads as a clinical pattern) -> 'Did I reply to that?'.
Removed bodily-symptom lines from nerves templates ('mouth so dry', racing heart, sweating) -> 'Where are my notes?'.
'Everything too loud' never says 'overstimulated' or 'sensory overload' on screen.
Escalation lines never use breath words ('deep breath') so nothing reads as an instruction; the breath is shown, never told.
R-BREATH: no counts, no holds, crest <= 0.35 s and unlabelled, exhale >= 1.5x inhale; no underwater ritual and G-SINK keeps the mouth above the waterline (no breath-hold reading).
'Cancel more things?' removed from the plans-cancelled pool (reads as encouraging withdrawal) -> 'Nobody move. Bliss.'.
'Your brain isn't broken' not used (implies a disorder frame).
Missing-someone and nostalgia may touch grief: gentle tone, gag intensity capped at 0.4, no 'gone forever' lines, no slapstick.
No heartbeat sounds (medical/anxiety connotation) and no alarm/ringtone imitations.
'LIFE OR DEATH' replaced in the decision template; no death jokes anywhere.
'Drink water', dentist, caffeine and food-guilt references avoided (health-advice adjacency).

slotGrammar.$doc: VideoSpec = template x slots. Tiers: plate slots change the rendered picture (expensive: ~20-30 min per 15 s on 4 CPU cores); overlay slots (hook + resolution text) can be re-composited cheaply IF the renderer emits a clean plate + caption overlay separately (small stage2 change). Thought lines live inside the glass bubbles, so they are plate slots.

mallow.constraint: realm ToDs intersect template ToDs; never in avoid

realm.from: mallows[m].realm (home realm only; no guest realms)

tod.constraint: must satisfy timeWords of the chosen hook/lines

palette.from: template.palette arc + realm base grade at tod
palette.jitter: world only: hue +/-6 deg, warmth +/-0.1, exposure +/-0.05; the Mallow is never recoloured

gag.from: template.gag.primary/alts intersect gags[g].mallows; 40% chance of the Mallow's signature gag if listed

lines.from: one from each of L1/L2/L3 pools (primary line counts as a pool member) or the curated primary triple
lines.constraint: no two lines in a triple start with the same word; <= 2 question marks per triple

ritual.from: template.ritual.primary/alts; signature rituals only for their Mallow; minDur must fit the RITUAL window

seed.controls: micro-timing +/-80 ms on non-sync beats, blink placement, glance targets, bubble orbit slots, mote seeds, decoy tab layout

score.controls: kit root (per Mallow), motif contour seed (rising/arch set), tick tempo +/-10%, pan seed; bed mood follows the palette arc
score.note: audio can be re-rendered and remuxed onto an existing picture (render.mjs --remux)

pipeline: 1 scheduler picks a template (cooldowns + feeling-family balance)
2 pick mallow (fit weights, not the previous post's Mallow) -> realm -> tod
3 pick gag, metaphor, ritual, camera within the template + Mallow capabilities
4 pick hook, line triple, resolution/closer under copy cooldowns; check timeWords vs tod; lint copy
5 fingerprint + distance check against the publish log; resample (max 50 tries)
6 compile beat clock for the duration -> body/face/world/camera/bubble tracks + sound cues (same structure as videos/my-brain-at-2am-v2.js)
7 render, then QA: verify.mjs spec/loudness, loop-seam delta, anti-flash luminance scan, safe-zone check, filmstrips

variationRules.fingerprint: hash(template, mallow, tod, gag, metaphor, ritual, L1, L2, L3, hook, resolution, camera, seed)
uniqueness: Never publish the same fingerprint twice.
Any two videos on the same channel within 14 days differ in >= 3 visible slots {mallow, hook text, line triple, ritual, gag, realm/tod, metaphor}, one of which is mallow or hook text.
Overlay-only variants (same plate, new hook/resolution) count as the same video for these rules; use them only for A/B hook tests or cross-platform versions, never as separate posts on one channel.
sequencing: No back-to-back posts with the same template, Mallow, ritual or gag (keeps the profile grid colourful and the format fresh).
Every Mallow appears at least once in any 10 consecutive posts; no Mallow more than 3 times in any 10.
Within any 7 posts: >= 4 feeling families and >= 2 positive or mixed-valence templates (the feed must not be all angst).
Same template at most twice per 7 days per channel; the approved T01 at most once per 7 days.
copyCooldowns: A hook text is not reused on a channel for 90 days; a thought line at most 3 times per 30 days; a resolution line at most once per 7 days.
No line appears in two templates (library-wide dedupe, enforced by the validator).
The brand line appears as the closer in about 30% of posts, never in more than 2 consecutive posts.
personality: A Mallow only plays a template where it is listed in primary/secondary; the performance is filtered through the app's PERSONALITY overrides (expressions.js), so the same beat reads differently on each Mallow.

Loomi under-reacts (comedy by contrast); Glitzi stays dry (smirk, never gushing); Blubi is allowed tears; Boppo bounces even when low; Zuzu's spiral speed tracks the overthinking; Pipzi's feelings come out as sparks; Noomi reacts sleepily and opens her eyes only on big beats.
Closed-eye Mallows (noomi, blubi, loomi) open their eyes only on strong beats (app eyeGate) and always start/end on the untouched painted face.
design: Only approved hi-res art (assets/source/hires/<id>.webp), never upscaled; no accessories, outfits, limbs or recolouring; squash height >= 0.6, stretch <= 1.3, uniform scale >= 0.6; the silhouette must always read as that Mallow.
Faces only from the app rig vocabulary (expressions.js presets + reactions.js), drawn at art resolution.
Each Mallow lives in its own realm; captions supply the human context (office, sofa) without redrawing the realm.

Cinematic restraint: no camera shake or roll, no cuts, no clutter (<= 3 legible texts + captions), no bouncing/shaking text, no flashes or strobing, no '!' glyph effects, sweat drops or outlined cartoon captions.
variationRules.capacity: Per template roughly 7 hooks x 64 line triples x 3 resolutions x 3-5 Mallows x 3 rituals x 3 gags x 1-2 cameras x 2-3 ToDs = 10^5-10^6 combinations; after the visible-distance rule, several hundred clearly distinct posts per template. Render budget on this machine is ~55 x 15 s videos/day, so variety is limited by rendering, not by the library.

templates.title: My Brain at 2 AM

escalation.staging: clouds swallow the moon, water chops, light goes cold, eyes chase the orbit

ritual.staging: the exhale carries the thoughts away as warm motes; clouds part, moon warms, lake stills

loop.staging: eyes drift shut, warmth eases back into night; hook returns and reads as '...every night'

beats: COVER: crickets + sleeping breath across the seam
ANTIC: dream flinch hum
GAG: eye-pop + boing + water plip
IMPACT: heavy wet flump, squelch, bloop, wobble tail
AFTER: blink bips, glances, clock that won't stop
L1-L3: glass tings rising 0/2/4, cringe squeak on L1
PEAK: orbit whooshes + tick accelerating + tension hum
TURN: everything stops dead
RITUAL: inhale / soft crest / long exhale, release squelch, dissolve chimes + sparkles, warm pad
OPEN: Noomi content glide
LOGO: closing chime

flags: Approved v2 reference; 'Why am I like this?' is playful, keep it out of templates about rejection.

avoid.pipzi: energy reads as party, not dread
